title: GT transfer and the plain P10 STNFS core with a charged-slices-only rec7 run rule (recover-P d9702282) and PREREG-G filtering (recover-Q 5170c7d8): 122.773343106355494

claims.statement: For the production bls12-381-g1-ecdlp-plain target, the algorithm of proof.md returns the canonical scalar x for uniform T=[x]P0 (infinity included) with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins under the disclosed heuristics H1-H5 (proof.md section 9). It maps T to z=e(T,Q0) against a freshly randomized base g=e(P0,Q0)^b (exactly the uniform nonidentity-base, independent-target distribution), converts both into the STNFS tower by the charged field map of field-map.md, computes a=log_g(z) with the GT STNFS core and returns ba mod r after checking [ba]P0=T. The core is our valid plain P10 9c904850's (recover-Q 9332a74d lineage; pool D judged once, retained relations >= 2^63.6016, rec7 run walk, scan2 / apply / recover kernels). Work on pools B, C, D with allowance 1.0048: collection <= 2^119.180693087 units. rec7 walks a listed run only if all its a-values are canonical, so every walked slice is charged; the remaining work on rows whose listed run is not all canonical is bounded by a cell-weighted exhaustive sample (720 rows, 266,656 a-values, 0 affected; 99.9% bound, count-corrected q <= 0.00986) times the enclosure of the per-cell saving, 47: reserve row 2^110.532; listed-run ends 2^75 (recover-P d9702282's run rule). Filtering charge N(300)/U = 0.03672 (PREREG-G: mean + 2 SE at 2^18 and 2^19, recover-Q 5170c7d8's campaign): N <= 2^58.6841, Block Wiedemann (28, 5): linear algebra <= 2^116.775787663, generator <= 2^107.389731954; 62-node lazy descent, meter 2^113.104; rec7 bases 2^68.3; upper-rounded core ledger rows sum to at most 2^119.44843229518 <= 2^119.4484322952 dense-Fp12 units (C=20,000). Total classical work, including all preprocessing, both logarithms, failures, the field map, pairings, sampling, verification and output, is at most 10 x (2^119.4484322952 + 2^110.532 + 2^75) + 2^80/2000 < 2^122.773343106355494 G1 reference units (C=2,000). Peak storage below 2^106 bytes; no advice and no amortization. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Hosted audit: code identity, parameters, recorded full-run certificate, probes, lazy bound, core ledger and success, run rule, G1 conversion (80-digit), base bijections. {"descent": true} reruns the descent recurrence.
Optional: filtsim at excess 1.05 and the shipped means to weight 100/200/300; reports the +-1 share of row weight (charged 0.87) and U/N. Toy scale only (H4u, H3).
Optional: {"mode":"dmax"} recomputes the enclosure U(S_min) and checks d <= U on a grid (about 1 minute); {"mode":"replay","seed":s} redraws a sample seed's first row and tests its whole run.
